subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

She gave the last seat in the boat to a stranger's child.

She is:
A) selfish
B) selfless
C) cruel

steps: Gave up safety. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The storm hammered its fists against the shore.

This is:
A) personification
B) a fact
C) a summary

To support an interpretation of a text, use:
A) the strongest textual evidence
B) a guess
C) the cover price

Read.

The reformer who fought corruption all his life took one bribe, once, and never forgave himself.

A theme is:
A) corruption always wins
B) conscience holds us to our own standards
C) reformers are wealthy
items.answer: B) conscience holds us to our own standards

steps: His guilt reveals the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) conscience holds us to our own standards

items.prompt:
Read.

'Oh, perfect,' she muttered as the last bus pulled away.

This is:
A) verbal irony (sarcasm)
B) a sincere statement
C) a metaphor

Read.

She gained the world's fame but lost her private self.

Two themes here are:
A) fame and the loss of self
B) only that fame is fun
C) only that she is famous
items.answer: A) fame and the loss of self

steps: Two interacting themes. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) fame and the loss of self

items.prompt:
Read.

The narrator insists the fire was 'just an accident,' yet he had bought the fuel that week and stood to collect the insurance.

The narrator is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claim contradicts the facts. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

An essay gravely proposes outlawing sleep to raise national productivity.

This is:
A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize
B) a serious policy plan
C) a science report
items.answer: A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize

steps: Absurd proposal = satire. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize
